display_rules.image: Original uint8 RGB arrays unchanged; no grayscale conversion, enhancement, normalization, cropping, or synthesis.
display_rules.FOV: Full original field and aspect ratio in every image; outer half-pixel guard permits complete boundary display.
display_rules.PDF: Native RGB raster embedded by interpolation=none; vector contours and text.
display_rules.SVG: Each image element embeds exact native RGB PNG; decoded equality asserted; crisp-edges/pixelated display; vector contours and editable text.
display_rules.contours: Binary level 0.5 of actual boolean arrays, padded with false exterior only to recover image-edge boundaries; no change to array geometry.
display_rules.prompts: Actual float32 boxes from each NPZ, unchanged; dashed gray; supplementary panels only.
display_rules.font: Liberation Sans; minimum 8 pt (row headers 8.15 pt); panel letters bold 10 pt.
display_rules.legend: Single shared legend per figure; reference blue #0072B2; CPU prediction orange #D55E00; actual prompt gray dashed.
display_rules.CPU_provenance: All displayed numeric values are independently recalculated CPU replay values; archived CUDA values retained separately.

metric_definitions.Dice: 2 * intersection foreground / sum of foreground counts (both empty convention 1; no masks empty here)

captions.Figure_5: Figure 5. Three shared screening misses in the external set. Rows show case089 (A–C), case175 (D–F), and case238 (G–I); columns show the original released RGB ultrasound image, the released reference contour (blue), and the actual initial CPU replay prediction contour (orange). Row values are CPU replay Dice against the reference and risks A and B, rather than the original archived CUDA scores. All panels preserve the full original image field and aspect ratio. In case175, the nonempty prediction includes a thin upper-edge band. Masks were captured in the six-case exact-checkpoint CPU replay; no new model inference was performed to create this figure. Original CUDA scores and primary study estimates were retained unchanged.
captions.Figure_S6: Supplementary Figure S6. Actual prompt-shift responses in the six-case CPU replay. S6A contains shared misses case089 (A), case175 (B), and case238 (C); S6B contains B-only detections case024 (D), case105 (E), and case222 (F). Each case panel shows the reference (blue) and initial CPU prediction (orange) at left. The right 2 × 2 grid shows actual predictions after left (top left), right (top right), up (bottom left), and down (bottom right) prompt shifts; orange denotes the displayed CPU prediction, blue the same reference, and dashed gray the actual prompt box. Each D value is the Dice between that shifted prediction and the initial CPU prediction, rather than its Dice against the reference. Row values give initial CPU Dice against the reference and risks A/B. All 30 nonempty prediction masks from the six existing patients are shown, with original RGB pixels, full fields of view, and unchanged mask geometry. The case175 masks touch the upper image boundary; the right-shift prediction is a narrow nonempty band. CPU masks are not the unarchived original CUDA masks, and original CUDA scores were not overwritten. These six cases are not additional independent patients.
